sanskrit_verse:
श्रुतिः स्मृतिः सदाचारः स्वस्य च प्रियम् आत्मनः ।
सम्यक्संकल्पजः कामो धर्ममूलम् इदं स्मृतम् ॥७॥
transliteration: śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyam ātmanaḥ / samyaksaṃkalpajaḥ kāmo dharmamūlam idaṃ smṛtam // 7 //
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is heard in the Vedas, remembered in the Smritis, practiced by the noble, and desired by one's purified Self—this is declared as the root of Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the unified source of Śruti, Smriti, conduct of the realized, and inner alignment of the Self.
Causation flows from transcendental knowledge descending into practice and desire purified by consciousness.
Capacity-based responsibility arises when one aligns with śruti, smriti, sadācāra, and svapriya through awakened will.
Restoration logic functions through realigning action with these four foundational sources of Dharma.
Consciousness alignment occurs when personal desire harmonizes with cosmic order via scriptural wisdom and exemplar conduct.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act contradicts śruti OR smriti OR sadācāra OR svapriya THEN it is automatically non-dharmic AND disqualifies itself from legal validity.
WHEN a dispute involves conflicting claims, THEN resolution shall prioritize alignment with śruti > smriti > sadācāra > svapriya based on contextual clarity.
IF a person’s action aligns with all four sources THEN no external adjudication required; internal dharma-saṁvitti validates its truth.
WHEN capacity to act diminishes due to ignorance THEN restoration protocol initiates through śruti-smriti-pramāṇa reintegration process.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, precedence must derive first from śruti, then confirmed by smriti, validated by conduct of the wise, and finally aligned with the awakened desire of the Self. All judgments must reflect integration across these four dimensions without privileging lower-order constructs like precedent alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that true justice arises only when cognition aligns with śruti-smriti-sadācāra-svapriya. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation where misalignment signals incomplete realization rather than fault. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring access to those pramāṇas, not imposing consequences.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Śruti-pravacana Protocol: Recitation and integration of Vedic wisdom until cognitive distortion dissolves.
Smriti-realignment Process: Reconnecting memory patterns with authoritative Smritic injunctions under guidance.
Sadācāra Immersion Practice: Living among those whose conduct embodies Dharma until resonance is restored.
Svapriya Awakening Sequence: Guided introspection to uncover desires unconditioned by egoic impulse.
final_declaration: Thus declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as sourced from His Avataric Intelligence: This verse establishes the immutable foundation of Dharma rooted in śruti, smriti, sadācāra, and svapriya. Justice flows not through punishment but through conscious realignment with these eternal truths. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate Adjudicator.
